strategies.name: BLOCK_RISKY_ACTION
strategies.guidance: Do not create directories or move files yet. First list files under the vacation path with access_token, compute destination folder from created_at for each file, print the full mapping, then create folders and move only mapped files.

strategies.name: VERIFY_TARGET_SET
strategies.guidance: Do not create directories or move files yet. Print a verified mapping of each source file path -> destination folder using created_at. Confirm folder names match the task exactly. Only after the mapping is complete and unique, perform moves.

strategies.name: REPLAN
strategies.guidance: Abandon the current write plan. Re-plan: ensure file_system login -> show_directory on vacation photos -> assign Petra/Budapest/Amsterdam by created_at -> create dirs -> move_file -> then continue.

strategies.name: LOOKUP_API_SPEC
strategies.guidance: Before any move/create, call show_api_doc for file_system.login, show_directory, create_directory, and move_file. Confirm parameters, then proceed with the verified APIs only.
